title: Austin Meeting Ends, Emphasizes ADA Access
summary:
*   The meeting officially concluded with an adjournment.
*   The city reiterated its commitment to Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) compliance.
*   Public accessibility resources, including a dedicated phone line (512-974-2210) and TTY services (via 711), were highlighted for assistance.
transcript:
ADJOURN
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711. 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act.
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request.
